# Sincerely Kitchen

> Shared commercial kitchen in Port Coquitlam, BC, Canada. Helps food entrepreneurs start and grow licensed food businesses.

## About

Sincerely Kitchen is a shared commercial kitchen (also known as a commissary kitchen) located in Port Coquitlam, British Columbia. Founded and operated by Maria. Over 200 food businesses have launched from this kitchen. The kitchen provides licensed commercial kitchen space, free permit assistance, flexible rental packages, and a supportive community for food entrepreneurs.

## Services

- Shared commercial kitchen rental (prep stations, commercial ovens, storage)
- Free permit and licensing assistance (Fraser Health, City of Port Coquitlam business licenses)
- Kitchen tours (free, 45-minute, no commitment)
- Community and mentorship for food business owners

## Packages

- **Starter 10**: From $490/month — 10 hours/month, ideal for getting started
- **Start Up**: From $690/month — 20 hours/month, for growing businesses
- **Ramp Up**: From $990/month — 40 hours/month, for scaling production
- **Scale Up**: From $1,350/month — 60 hours/month, for high-volume production

All packages include prep station access, commercial equipment, dry storage, and free permit assistance.
